set.layering_notes: Huntington Beach's local code mirrors the pre-2020 state schedule (35% cap), but state law controls and allows larger bonuses; the practical constraint is political and legal (Measure U voter control, State v. City of Huntington Beach over the Housing Element). Until the element is certified, projects may use builder's remedy and the City cannot earn Prohousing points. No local fee waiver ordinance beyond the Sec. 230.26 fee-reduction incentive. Density bonus does not trigger prevailing wage. Code read on zoneomics; HCD March 6, 2026 letter and Legistar matter list opened. HCD's Housing Element Compliance Report (updated November 6, 2026) shows the adopted element received June 19, 2026 and found out of compliance on August 18, 2026.
